model: XGBoost LambdaMART on molecular representations and fit-selected substructure counts
inner_split: scaffold holdout using existing inner_split; fit-only iteration selection
final_refit: Train plus official valid labels; no blind test labels
selection: Same positive mean OOF and valid gain criteria as rare branch, at least 2/3 fold gains >= -0.002
limitation: Repeatedly reused scaffold OOF and validation are selection diagnostics, not a guarantee or unbiased score estimate.
